# 编译器 API

`krieg-lang/compiler` 在 Node.js 中读取、检查并静态翻译源文件。成功结果包含 PDX AST 或 Lua 文本的判别联合；只有项目构建 API 会写入模组目录。

## CompileOptions

```ts
export interface CompileOptions {
  rootDir: string;
  files: string[];
  outDir?: string;
  /** Declaration-only module bodies. Never evaluated as JavaScript. */
  virtualModules?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Explicitly resolved .krg.ts package entry points. */
  moduleFiles?: Record<string, string>;
  /** In-memory source overrides, keyed by absolute or root-relative filename. */
  sources?: Record<string, string>;
  schema?: CwtSchema;
  include?: string[];
  maxExpansion?: number;
  /** Project batch drivers set false and compile each source as an entry exactly once. */
  emitDependencies?: boolean;
}
```

| `emitDependencies` | Project batch drivers set false and compile each source as an entry exactly once. |

## CwtSchema

```ts
export interface CwtSchema {
  formatVersion: 1;
  provenance: { source: string; sha256: string; files: number };
  /** Overloads remain separate; dynamic names such as <scripted_effect> are retained. */
  commands: CwtCommandRule[];
  scopes: string[];
  singleAliases: Record<string, CwtValueRule>;
  /** Every definition is retained when an alias is overloaded in the CWT source. */
  singleAliasOverloads?: Record<string, CwtValueRule[]>;
  diagnostics: { source: string; line: number; message: string }[];
}
```

源码：[src/schema/types.ts:24](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/schema/types.ts#L24)

| `commands`             | Overloads remain separate; dynamic names such as <scripted_effect> are retained. |
| `singleAliasOverloads` | Every definition is retained when an alias is overloaded in the CWT source.      |

## CwtValueRule

A conservative, provenance-bearing projection of CWT rules, not CWTools.

```ts
export interface CwtValueRule {
  type: "scalar" | "block";
  /** Literal CWT value expression, e.g. int, bool, <idea>, scope[country]. */
  expression: string;
  fields?: CwtFieldRule[];
}
```
